description: Construction number 2675. Delivered to Air France in 1951 as F-BBDT and transferred to Royal Air Maroc in 1960. Retired from service in 1970 and used as a training airframe at Anfa. Restored and repainted in historic Royal Air Maroc colours in 2004 and 2005. Constellation Survivors records it still parked outside the hangar in October 2022 and Wrecks and Relics Online last noted the group October 2024.
